definitions.explanation: A customer a business already has, as opposed to one it is trying to win. Standard marketing and sales vocabulary, usually contrasted with {新規|しんき}{客|きゃく} (new customers).

examples.japanese: {既存客|きぞんきゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にしたい。
examples.english: We want to take good care of our existing customers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{既存客|きぞんきゃく}⟦のみ→のみ：06546_nomi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧だ。
examples.english: This discount applies only to existing customers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新規|しんき}{開拓|かいたく}→新規開拓：18121_shinkikaitaku⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{既存客|きぞんきゃく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{維持|いじ}→維持：01624_iji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}なくて→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦{済|す}む→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: Retaining existing customers costs less than developing new ones.

notes:
Formed from {既存|きぞん} (existing, already in place) plus ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧ (customer). The fuller {既存|きぞん}⟦{顧客|こきゃく}→顧客：08632_kokyaku⟧ is also common and sounds slightly more formal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {既存客|きぞんきゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{維持|いじ}する→維持する：17311_ijisuru⟧: to retain existing customers
- {既存客|きぞんきゃく}{向|む}け⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧: services aimed at existing customers
- {既存客|きぞんきゃく}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧: a referral from an existing customer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{新規|しんき}{客|きゃく}→新規客：30163_shinkikyaku⟧: new customer — the standard contrast
- ⟦{常連|じょうれん}→常連：06878_jouren⟧: regular customer — everyday word implying repeated, familiar visits rather than a database category
